name: What is the typical timeline for a kitchen renovation project?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for a kitchen renovation project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a kitchen renovation varies depending on the scope of work, material selections, and any unforeseen structural issues. Generally, a complete kitchen remodel can take anywhere from 6 to 12 weeks from demolition to final installation. This includes planning, material ordering, demolition, rough-ins for plumbing and electrical, cabinet installation, countertop fabrication and installation, flooring, and final finishes. Custom cabinetry or unique material choices can extend this timeframe. We work to provide a detailed schedule upfront to manage expectations.
acceptedAnswer.description: A kitchen renovation typically takes 6 to 12 weeks, depending on the project's scope and material choices.
